verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an open-source, self-hostable database like Chroma, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Being able to run locally or self-host (Apache 2.0) is related to privacy but is not a documented telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
